description: P0.0 non-claim policy for preventing Cargo regression in active CI/CD/build/script lanes. This file is not a green readiness claim; it defines local/static enforcement and the target controller chain.
policy_summary: Buck2 is the only CI/CD/build/script execution authority. Cargo CLI build/test/run/check/fmt/clippy/nextest/bench/deny/cyclonedx/install invocations are forbidden in active lanes. The only executable Cargo exception is production release image/binary optimization and must carry release evidence for binary-size, codegen, linking, PGO, or memory allocator measurements. Cargo metadata/vendor for Buck2/Reindeer graph generation is metadata-only and never build/test/merge authority.
